title: Phones, apps & payments
goal: Sort out a phone or app that won't work, pay and send money by phone, shop online, and talk about posts, likes and follows — the way people in Sindh actually do.
intro:
Phone Sindhi is half English, and that's fine: **ايپ اپڊيٽ ڪر**, **ڪوڊ اسڪين ڪريو**, **پوسٽ وائرل ٿي وئي**. The trick is the Sindhi verb that comes after the English word — **ڪرڻ** when *you* do it, **ٿيڻ** when it just *happens* — and that verb carries all the grammar.

You'll also practise **real conditionals** the way people use them with technology: **جيڪڏهن ڪوڊ نه آيو ته …** 'if the code doesn't come …', often shortened to just **… ته …**. And you'll learn to pay the Pakistani way — by JazzCash, Easypaisa and QR code — with a screenshot as proof.

grammar.title: Real conditionals in practice: جيڪڏهن … ته …, and just … ته …
grammar.body:
Unit 19 introduced **جيڪڏهن … ته …** 'if … then …'. With phones and payments you'll use it constantly, so here is how it really works in speech.

**1. The if-clause often uses the past for the future.** Where English says *if the code **doesn't come***, Sindhi often says 'if the code **didn't come**': جيڪڏهن ڪوڊ نه **آيو** ته … · جيڪڏهن پئسا نه **پهتا** ته … This past form looks backwards but means 'if (at that point) it hasn't happened'.

**2. Present for things true right now:** جيڪڏهن نيٽ **نٿو هلي** ته … 'if the internet isn't working (now)'. **Subjunctive** for open possibilities and offers: جيڪڏهن توهان **چاهيو** ته … 'if you like …', جيڪڏهن فون هينگ **ٿئي** ته … 'if the phone (ever) freezes'.

**3. Drop جيڪڏهن.** In quick speech the **ته** in the middle is enough to mark a condition: پئسا نه پهتا **ته** ٻڌاءِ 'let me know if the money doesn't arrive'. Don't drop ته, though — it is the real signal.

**4. The then-clause** is an instruction (imperative or -jo form), a future, or a general present: … ته وري ڪوشش ڪجو · … ته رعايت ملندي · … ته مهانگو ٿو ملي.

**Even if** = جيڪڏهن … **ته به**: جيڪڏهن سيل آهي **ته به** نه وٺندس 'even if there's a sale, I won't buy it'. **Otherwise** = **نه ته** (unit 19): جلدي پيمينٽ ڪريو، نه ته آفر ختم ٿي ويندي.

grammar.title: English words + ڪرڻ / ٿيڻ
grammar.body:
Tech English comes into Sindhi as a **noun + a Sindhi verb**, and the Sindhi verb carries all the grammar — tense, person, gender.

**+ ڪرڻ** when someone does it to something (transitive): **ڊائونلوڊ ڪرڻ**، **شيئر ڪرڻ**، **فالو ڪرڻ**، **اسڪين ڪرڻ**، **اپڊيٽ ڪرڻ**، **ٽرانسفر ڪرڻ**، **پوسٽ ڪرڻ**.
**+ ٿيڻ** when it just happens (intransitive): **ڊائونلوڊ ٿيڻ**، **اپڊيٽ ٿيڻ**، **ٽرانسفر ٿيڻ**، **هينگ ٿيڻ**، **هيڪ ٿيڻ**، **وائرل ٿيڻ**.
It is the same pair you know from Sindhi words: شروع ڪرڻ / شروع ٿيڻ (unit 16), ختم ڪرڻ / ختم ٿيڻ.

**In the past**, the normal rules apply (unit 16):
• with **ڪرڻ**, the doer is oblique (مون، تو، هن) and ڪيو / ڪئي / ڪيا agrees with the **object**: مون فوٽو شيئر **ڪيو** (فوٽو m) · مون پوسٽ شيئر **ڪئي** (پوسٽ f) · مون پئسا ٽرانسفر **ڪيا** (pl).
• with **ٿيڻ**, the verb agrees with the **subject**: فون هينگ **ٿي ويو** (m) · ايپ اپڊيٽ **ٿي وئي** (f) · پئسا ٽرانسفر **ٿي ويا** (pl).

**Gender of English words**: each gets one, and you learn it with the word. Many are masculine (فوٽو، لنڪ، ڪوڊ، اڪائونٽ، بٽڻ، لائيڪ، ڪمينٽ), but quite a few are feminine — ايپ، پوسٽ، پيمينٽ، اپڊيٽ، سيل، آفر، شاپنگ.

And don't forget the plain Sindhi verbs that go with phones: **کولڻ** 'open', **بند ڪرڻ** 'close, switch off', **دٻائڻ** 'press', **هلڻ** 'work, run' (نيٽ نٿو هلي), **موڪلڻ** 'send'.

culture:
In Pakistan the phone wallet is king. **JazzCash** and **Easypaisa** are everywhere — even in small towns in Sindh — for sending money home, paying bills, splitting a meal or paying a rickshaw, and their names work as verbs: **پئسا جاز ڪيش ڪر**. Shops increasingly show a QR code for **Raast** bank transfers, but cash is still common, and online shops like Daraz usually offer cash on delivery. After any transfer, people send a **اسڪرين شاٽ** as proof — asking for one isn't rude.

WhatsApp is the backbone of social life (family groups, voice notes, forwarded 'good morning' images), Facebook is huge with older users, and TikTok and YouTube are full of Sindhi comedy, music and news. Many young people write Sindhi on their phones in the **Roman alphabet** ('kithe aahin?') rather than in Sindhi script, though Sindhi keyboards are easy to install.

Tech talk mixes languages freely — **ايپ اپڊيٽ ڪر**, **نيٽ نٿو هلي**, **اڪائونٽ هيڪ ٿي ويو** — and nobody expects you to use a 'pure' Sindhi word for 'download'. Do watch out for scam calls and messages asking for your **ڪوڊ**: banks and wallets never ask for it.

lessons.title: When your phone won't work

tip.title: English word + ڪرڻ or ٿيڻ
tip.body:
- **ڪرڻ** when you do it: ايپ اپڊيٽ **ڪر**، ڊائونلوڊ **ڪريو**.
- **ٿيڻ** when it just happens: فون هينگ **ٿي ويو**، ايپ اپڊيٽ **ٿي وئي**.
- Past with ڪرڻ: ڪيو / ڪئي agrees with the **object**: مون ايپ ڊائونلوڊ **ڪئي** (ايپ f).

lessons.title: If it goes wrong: codes, links and hacks

tip.title: If … then: جيڪڏهن … ته
tip.body:
- The if-clause often uses the **past** for the future: جيڪڏهن ڪوڊ نه **آيو** ته … 'if the code doesn't come'.
- **ته** starts the then-part, and in speech it's enough on its own: پئسا نه پهتا **ته** ٻڌاءِ.
- Then-part: an instruction or a future.

tip.title: JazzCash, Easypaisa and screenshots
tip.body:
- Brand names become verbs: پئسا **جاز ڪيش ڪرڻ** / **ايزي پيسا ڪرڻ**.
- You transfer: **ٽرانسفر ڪرڻ**; it goes through: **ٽرانسفر ٿيڻ**.
- 'Not yet' = **اڃا نه**: پئسا اڃا نه پهتا.
- Ask for an **اسڪرين شاٽ** as proof — that's normal.

sentences.roman: moṃ amāṃ khe ɗaha hazāra ṭrānsfaru kayā.
sentences.en: I transferred ten thousand to Mum.

sentences.native: هتي ڪارڊ هلي ٿو يا رڳو نقد؟
sentences.roman: hite kārḍu hale tho yā raɠo naqdu?
sentences.en: Do you take cards here, or only cash?

sentences.native: پيمينٽ جو اسڪرين شاٽ ضرور موڪلجو.
sentences.roman: pemenṭa jo skrīn shāṭu zarūr mokilijo.
sentences.en: Be sure to send a screenshot of the payment.

lessons.title: Posting, sharing and following
new: هي فوٽو ڪنهن سان شيئر نه ڪر!
مون کي انسٽاگرام تي فالو ڪر.

sentences.native: هي فوٽو ڪنهن سان شيئر نه ڪر! مان ڏاڍو خراب پيو لڳان.
sentences.roman: hī foṭo kanhin sāṃ shearu na karu! māṃ ɗāḍho xarābu peyo laɠāṃ.
sentences.en: Don't share this photo with anyone! I look awful. (man)

sentences.native: تو منهنجي پوسٽ شيئر ڪئي؟ مهرباني!
sentences.roman: to munhinjī posṭa shearu kaī? meharbānī!
sentences.en: You shared my post? Thanks!

sentences.native: هن سوشل ميڊيا تي اسان جو فوٽو پوسٽ ڪيو.
sentences.roman: hun soshal meḍiyā te asāṃ jo foṭo posṭa kayo.
sentences.en: She posted our photo on social media.

sentences.native: مون کي انسٽاگرام تي فالو ڪر، يار.
sentences.roman: moṃ khe insṭāgrām te fālo karu, yār.
sentences.en: Follow me on Instagram, mate.

sentences.native: مان توهان کي فيسبوڪ تي فالو ڪريان ٿو.
sentences.roman: māṃ tavhāṃ khe fesbuk te fālo karyāṃ tho.
sentences.en: I follow you on Facebook. (man)

sentences.native: اڄڪلهه سڀ سوشل ميڊيا تي آهن.
sentences.roman: aʄkalha sabhu soshal meḍiyā te āhin.
sentences.en: Everyone's on social media these days.

sentences.native: هن جون پوسٽون ڏاڍيون مزيدار هونديون آهن.
sentences.roman: hun jūṃ posṭūṃ ɗāḍhyūṃ mazedāra hundyūṃ āhin.
sentences.en: Her posts are always really fun.

sentences.native: فوٽو موڪل، مان پوسٽ ڪندس.
sentences.roman: foṭo mokilu, māṃ posṭa kandus.
sentences.en: Send the photo, I'll post it. (man)

lessons.title: Likes, sales and shopping online
new: تنهنجي پوسٽ وائرل ٿي وئي آهي!

sentences.native: ڊراز تي سيل لڳي آهي! سڀ ڪجهه اڌ قيمت تي.
sentences.roman: ḍarāz te sela laɠī āhe! sabhu kujhu adha qīmata te.
sentences.en: There's a sale on Daraz! Everything's half price.

sentences.native: تنهنجي پوسٽ وائرل ٿي وئي آهي! پنج هزار لائيڪ!
sentences.roman: tunhinjī posṭa vāiral thī vaī āhe! panja hazāra lāika!
sentences.en: Your post has gone viral! Five thousand likes!

sentences.native: ڪمينٽ ۾ لک ته ڪٿان ورتو.
sentences.roman: kamenṭa meṃ likhu ta kithāṃ varto.
sentences.en: Write in the comments where you bought it.

sentences.native: منهنجي ويڊيو تي ڪو لائيڪ ئي نه آيو.
sentences.roman: munhinjī viḍiyo te ko lāiku ī na āyo.
sentences.en: My video didn't get a single like.

sentences.native: جيڪڏهن سيل ختم ٿي وئي ته پوءِ مهانگو ملندو.
sentences.roman: jekaɗahiṃ sela xatmu thī vaī ta poi mahāngo milando.
sentences.en: If the sale ends, it'll cost more.

sentences.native: اها آفر رڳو اڄ تائين آهي.
sentences.roman: uhā āfara raɠo aʄu tāīṃ āhe.
sentences.en: That offer's only on till today.

sentences.native: مان آن لائين شاپنگ گهٽ ڪندي آهيان.
sentences.roman: māṃ ān lāin shāpinga ghaṭu kandī āhiyāṃ.
sentences.en: I don't shop online much. (woman)

sentences.native: هن جا ڪمينٽ پڙهي مون کي کل اچي وئي.
sentences.roman: hun jā kamenṭa paṛhī moṃ khe khila achī vaī.
sentences.en: Reading his comments, I burst out laughing.
